label: scope
comment: A list of relevant standards and/or regulations against which apply to this attestation (eg AS1163:2016).

rangeIncludes.comment: A formal governance scheme under which this attestation is issued (eg ACRS structural steel certification)

domainIncludes.comment: A conformity attestation issued by a competent body that defines one or more assessments (eg carbon intensity) about a product (eg batttery) against a specification (eg LCA method) defined in a standard or regulation.
